question: How do I submit a talk proposal?
answer: Head to our Call for Proposals page and submit the form. Talks can be in English or Indonesian, and we welcome speakers at every career stage, from first-time presenters to experienced engineers.

question: What kind of talks are you looking for?
answer: We look for sessions that help developers solve real problems in production: systems architecture, web and mobile engineering, applied AI, reliability, and technical leadership.

question: What talk formats are available?
answer: You can submit a 30-minute main talk or a 7-minute lightning talk. Both take place on the single conference track.

question: When will the speaker lineup be announced?
answer: We will publish the full lineup after the CFP closes on September 26, 2026. Follow our community channels or check back here for confirmed speakers.

question: How can I get a ticket?
answer: Ticket registration is not open yet. We will announce ticket release dates here and on our social channels once sales go live.

question: Will food and drinks be provided?
answer: Yes, snacks and refreshments are provided throughout both days. If you have dietary requirements, let us know when registering and we will accommodate you.

question: Is there a refund policy?
answer: Tickets are non-refundable once purchased. If your plans change, you can transfer your ticket to a colleague or friend. Email us and we will help transfer the name.

question: Where can I find the latest event updates?
answer: This website is the official source of truth for IDSW 2026. We also post announcements and schedule updates across our community social channels.

question: What should I bring on the day of the event?
answer: Bring your ticket confirmation email and a valid ID for check-in. A laptop is optional for note-taking and hallway discussions. If you have questions before the event, email us at idsw@perkodi.org.

question: How do I become a sponsor?
answer: Download the official sponsorship proposal from the Sponsors section, or email idsw.sponsor@perkodi.org to connect with our partnership team.
